Captured on 2026-10-21 using `launchctl print gui/<uid>/<label>` for an
already-running Apple LaunchAgent on the local Mac. No service was changed.
The fixture preserves the complete indentation, block structure and ordering.
All labels, paths, arguments, environment entries and other scalar values are
redacted; pid/runs use synthetic values. Both later nested `state = active`
lines are from the captured output, after the top-level `state = running`.
